butt-weld-180-return-bends.meta_title: Butt Weld 180° Return Bend | Stainless Steel
butt-weld-180-return-bends.meta_description: Reverse flow direction with our 180° return bend. Butt weld design, smooth flow, and durable stainless steel for industrial systems.
butt-weld-180-return-bends.description:

This fitting connects two pipes through a seamless butt weld joint, ensuring a strong, permanent, and leak-free connection.

Manufactured from high-quality 304 or 316 stainless steel, it offers excellent corrosion resistance and durability in demanding environments. The smooth internal surface minimizes turbulence and pressure loss, helping maintain efficient system performance.

Commonly used in HVAC, liquid cooling, and sanitary processing systems, this return bend is essential for applications requiring reliable flow redirection while maintaining structural integrity and clean fluid paths.

roll-on-expanding-ferrules.meta_description: Install tri-clamp connections easily with roll-on expanding ferrules. Durable stainless steel, smooth finish, ideal for sanitary piping systems.
roll-on-expanding-ferrules.description:
The Cardinal Cooling Systems Roll-On Expanding Ferrules are designed to create reliable tri-clamp connections on existing tubing without the need for full butt welding. These ferrules slide over the pipe and are then welded into place, offering a practical solution for system modifications, repairs, or retrofits in sanitary piping networks.

Manufactured from high-quality 304 or 316L stainless steel, they provide excellent corrosion resistance and durability in demanding environments. Their design ensures a secure, leak-resistant connection while maintaining compatibility with standard tri-clamp assemblies.

Commonly used in food processing, dairy, and liquid cooling systems, these ferrules support efficient installation and reliable performance where clean, adaptable connections are essential.

150-pipe-flange.meta_description: Secure pipe connections with our Class 150 pipe flange. Durable, leak-resistant, and ideal for low-pressure HVAC and industrial systems.
150-pipe-flange.description:
The Cardinal Cooling Systems 150 Pipe Flange is designed to provide secure, bolted connections between pipes, valves, and equipment in low-pressure piping systems. Engineered to ANSI/ASME Class 150 standards, this flange ensures compatibility, reliability, and easy installation across a wide range of industrial and utility applications.

Manufactured from high-quality stainless steel, it offers excellent corrosion resistance and long-term durability in demanding environments. The bolted flange design allows for quick assembly and disassembly, making maintenance and system modifications more efficient compared to permanent welded connections.

Ideal for HVAC systems, water pipelines, and general process applications, this Class 150 flange is optimized for low-pressure and moderate-temperature conditions, delivering dependable sealing and structural integrity.

single-pin-heavy-duty-clamp-with-wing-nu.meta_title: Single Pin Clamp with Wing Nut | Heavy Duty SS
single-pin-heavy-duty-clamp-with-wing-nu.meta_description: Secure tri-clamp connections with our single pin heavy-duty clamp. Stainless steel, durable, and leak-proof design for sanitary systems.
single-pin-heavy-duty-clamp-with-wing-nu.description:

Manufactured from high-quality 304 or 316 stainless steel, it offers excellent corrosion resistance and long-term durability in demanding environments. Ideal for food processing, pharmaceutical systems, and liquid cooling applications, this clamp ensures consistent performance, easy maintenance, and dependable sealing in high-purity and pressure-sensitive environments.

king-combination-nipple.meta_title: King Combination Nipple | Hose to Pipe Adapter
king-combination-nipple.meta_description: Connect hose to pipe easily with our king combination nipple. Durable, leak-proof design in stainless steel and multiple sizes.
king-combination-nipple.description:
The Cardinal Cooling Systems King Combination Nipple is a versatile hose fitting designed to provide a secure connection between hoses and threaded piping systems. Manufactured from durable materials such as stainless steel, plated steel, or brass, this fitting ensures long-lasting performance and corrosion resistance in demanding environments. Its barbed design firmly grips hoses, helping prevent slippage and ensuring a reliable, leak-resistant connection under low-pressure fluid transfer applications.

Ideal for industrial fluid handling, irrigation, and cooling systems, the king combination nipple offers a simple yet effective solution for building efficient and dependable hose-to-pipe connections.

butt-weld-reducing-tee.meta_title: Butt Weld Reducing Tee | Stainless Steel Fitting
butt-weld-reducing-tee.meta_description: Connect three pipes with precision using our butt weld reducing tee. Leak-free, durable, and available in 304/316 stainless steel.
butt-weld-reducing-tee.description:
The Cardinal Cooling Systems Butt Weld Reducing Tee is engineered for efficient branching in piping systems where a smaller outlet is required. This fitting connects three pipes at right angles, with one reduced branch that enables controlled flow distribution across industrial and sanitary applications.

Manufactured from high-quality 304 or 316 stainless steel, it offers excellent corrosion resistance and long-term durability. The butt weld ends create a permanent, high-strength connection that minimizes leakage and supports high-pressure performance.

Designed for smooth internal flow, this reducing tee helps reduce turbulence and maintain system efficiency. It is widely used in liquid cooling systems, process piping, and high-purity environments where reliability and clean flow paths are essential.

male-npt-x-weld-end-adapter.meta_title: Male NPT x Weld End Adapter | 316L Stainless Steel
male-npt-x-weld-end-adapter.meta_description: Secure your transition from threaded ports to welded tubing with our Male NPT x Weld End Adapter. 3-A certified, 32Ra finish, available in 304/316L.
male-npt-x-weld-end-adapter.description:
The Cardinal Cooling Systems Male NPT x Weld End Adapter is the definitive solution for engineers and technicians who need to transition from standard threaded equipment to permanent, welded stainless steel lines. This versatile fitting allows you to connect threaded components — such as pressure sensors, cooling manifolds, or pumps — directly into a welded tubing network without the need for complex intermediate adapters.

Constructed from industrial-grade 304 or 316L stainless steel, this adapter is built to withstand the rigors of modern liquid cooling environments. The butt-weld end provides a seamless, flush connection that can be orbitally welded for a permanent, leak-free joint, while the NPT end offers the convenience of traditional threaded assembly.

The interior bore is polished to a 32Ra finish, reducing fluid friction and ensuring that the system remains easy to clean and free of contaminants. Whether you are managing the thermal demands of high-performance computing or routing fluids in a pharmaceutical production line, this adapter delivers the structural integrity and 3-A certified performance required for top-tier industrial infrastructure.

union-hexagonal-nut.meta_title: Union Hexagonal Nut | 13H Stainless Steel Bevel Seat Nut
union-hexagonal-nut.meta_description: Secure your cooling systems with our Union Hexagonal Nut. Made from 304/316L stainless steel, 3-A certified 13H nut is rated for 400 PSI.
union-hexagonal-nut.description:
The Cardinal Cooling Systems Union Hexagonal Nut is a foundational component for securing high-performance sanitary connections in industrial liquid cooling and fluid processing systems. Forged from premium 304 or 316L stainless steel, this hex nut is engineered to thrive in environments where exposure to moisture, chemicals, and temperature fluctuations is constant. Its robust construction allows for a 400 PSI pressure tolerance, ensuring system integrity even under significant thermal loads or high-flow conditions. The precision-threaded interior provides a smooth, consistent fit that minimizes the risk of galling or cross-threading during installation.

Beyond its structural strength, the Union Hexagonal Nut is optimized for hygiene. Its easy-access hexagonal design allows maintenance teams to quickly break down connections for inspection or deep cleaning, making it an essential choice for data center cooling, pharmaceutical production, and food-grade processing where downtime must be minimized and purity must be maintained.

90-clamp-elbow.meta_title: 90° Clamp Elbow | Stainless Steel Sanitary Tri-Clamp Fitting

y-ball-check-valves.description:
The Cardinal Cooling Systems Y Ball Check Valve is engineered for sanitary process systems where reliable backflow prevention and smooth fluid movement are critical. Its Y-body design allows the internal ball to move freely out of the flow path during operation, ensuring minimal pressure drop and uninterrupted flow performance.

When fluid flows forward, the ball is lifted into the branch section of the valve, allowing full flow through the line. Once flow stops or reverses, the ball automatically returns to the seat, creating a secure seal that prevents backflow and protects system integrity.

Manufactured from high-quality 304 or 316L stainless steel with a polished sanitary finish, this valve meets strict 3A standards for hygienic applications.
